tasks.prompt: Add a deterministic repair planner for ADE. Create src/ade/repair_planner.py with an immutable RepairPlan dataclass containing task_id, failure_kind, disposition, next_attempt, next_replan_count, and error_summary. Add plan_repair(task_id, exc, attempt, replan_count, policy) which uses classify_failure and decide_repair from ade.repair, increments next_attempt only for RETRY, increments next_replan_count only for REPLAN, leaves counters unchanged for PAUSE_QUOTA/HUMAN_WAIT/FAIL, and stores a bounded non-empty error_summary without leaking tracebacks. Validate non-empty task_id and non-negative counters. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage for retry, replan, quota pause, human wait, terminal fail, and invalid inputs. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
tasks.title: Add deterministic repair planner
